faqContent.a: League Roulette is a web-based challenge platform for League of Legends players. It randomly selects champions for you to play, helping you expand your champion pool, improve game knowledge, and have fun with unpredictable matches. The platform tracks your progress, awards XP and achievements, and features global leaderboards.

faqContent.q: Is League Roulette free to use?
faqContent.a: Yes! League Roulette is completely free to use. All core features including champion selection, automatic verification, XP tracking, achievements, and leaderboards are available to all users at no cost.

faqContent.q: Do I need to download anything?
faqContent.a: No downloads required! League Roulette runs entirely in your web browser. You only need League of Legends installed on your computer to play the actual matches.

faqContent.q: How do I create an account?
faqContent.a: Click the "Login to Track Progress" button on the homepage and authenticate with your Riot Games account. We use Riot's official OAuth system, so your credentials are secure and never stored on our servers.

faqContent.q: How does the champion selection work?
faqContent.a: First, select your preferred lane (Top, Jungle, Mid, ADC, Support, or All Lanes). Then click "Pull the Lever" to spin the slot machine roulette. The system randomly selects a champion from your chosen lane pool.

faqContent.q: Can I reroll if I don't like the champion?
faqContent.a: Yes! You have unlimited spins per challenge. If you don't like your champion, you can keep rerolling until you find one you want to play.

faqContent.q: What game modes count for verification?
faqContent.a: All official League of Legends game modes count: Ranked Solo/Duo, Ranked Flex, Normal Draft, Normal Blind Pick, and ARAM. Custom games and practice tool matches do not count.
Our system checks your match history every 2 minutes using the official Riot Games API. When it detects a new match with your assigned champion, it automatically verifies the result.

faqContent.q: How much XP do I earn per challenge?
faqContent.a: You earn 100 XP for each successfully completed challenge. Every 1,000 XP equals one level. So you need 10 successful challenges to level up.
League Roulette features multiple achievement categories: First Steps, Consistency, Win Streaks, Leveling, and Special achievements for unique accomplishments.
There are 5 leaderboard categories: Total XP, Highest Level, Most Challenges, Current Streak, and Best Streak. You can switch between categories to see where you rank.
Absolutely. We use Riot's official OAuth authentication system. Your Riot username and password are never shared with or stored on our servers.
All League of Legends regions are supported: EUW, EUNE, NA, KR, BR, LAN, LAS, OCE, TR, RU, JP, PH, SG, TH, TW, and VN.

faqContent.q: Does League Roulette work on mobile?
faqContent.a: Yes! The website is fully responsive and works on mobile phones and tablets.

tipsContent.intro: Playing random champions is one of the best ways to improve at League of Legends. This guide will help you succeed with unfamiliar champions, understand different playstyles, and develop the adaptability needed to win with anyone.
tipsContent.g1Text: When you can't rely on champion-specific mechanics, your fundamentals become even more important. Focus on:
tipsContent.g1Bullet1: CS'ing: Last-hitting minions is universal across all champions
tipsContent.g1Bullet2: Map awareness: Watch minimap, track enemy jungler, ward key areas
tipsContent.g1Bullet3: Positioning: Stay safe in teamfights, respect enemy threats
tipsContent.g1Bullet4: Wave management: Freeze when ahead, push when roaming
tipsContent.g2Text: Before the game starts, spend 2-3 minutes learning your champion. Read ability descriptions in champion select, check recommended builds, and watch a quick 30-second YouTube clip if available.
tipsContent.g3Text: Don't try to make flashy plays with unfamiliar champions. Focus on farming safely, learning your damage output, and understanding your power spikes.
tipsContent.g4Text: Even if you don't know all the mechanics, you can understand your role: Are you a tank meant to engage? A carry who needs gold? A support enabling teammates?
tipsContent.topText: Top lane is an island where 1v1 skill determines success. Most random top laners will be either bruisers or tanks.
tipsContent.top1: Trading stance: Position aggressively when enemy is last-hitting
tipsContent.top2: Wave control: Freeze near your tower when ahead, essential for top
tipsContent.top3: TP usage: Save teleport for bot lane plays or getting back to lane
tipsContent.top4: Split pushing: Most top laners excel at side lane pressure late game
tipsContent.jngText: Jungle is the most game-knowledge-dependent role. Focus on these basics with random junglers:
tipsContent.jng1: Clear efficiency: Learn the optimal clear path - usually start Raptors or Buff
tipsContent.jng2: Gank setup: Only gank lanes with CC or when enemies are overextended
tipsContent.jng3: Objective control: Dragons and Rift Herald win games, prioritize them
tipsContent.jng4: Track enemy jungler: Ward their jungle, ping locations to team
tipsContent.midText: Mid lane has the most diverse champion pool - from mages to assassins to bruisers.
tipsContent.mid1: Roaming: Push wave then roam to side lanes, mid has the best roam access
tipsContent.mid2: Mana management: Many mid laners are mana-gated, don't spam abilities
tipsContent.mid3: Assassin vs Mage: Assassins look for picks, mages provide teamfight DPS
tipsContent.mid4: Vision control: Ward both river bushes to avoid ganks
tipsContent.adcText: ADCs are mechanically demanding but follow similar patterns across all champions.
tipsContent.adc1: Attack move: Use A-click to kite and avoid misclicks
tipsContent.adc2: Positioning: Stay max range in fights, behind your frontline
tipsContent.adc3: Trading in lane: Auto-attack when enemy goes for CS
tipsContent.adc4: Scaling focus: Most ADCs need 2-3 items to be strong, farm safely
tipsContent.supText: Support has the most varied playstyles - enchanters, tanks, mages all play differently.
tipsContent.sup1: Vision game: Always have wards up, deny enemy vision with sweeper
tipsContent.sup2: Engage vs Peel: Tank supports engage, enchanters protect carries
tipsContent.sup3: Roaming: When ADC is safely farming, roam mid for plays
tipsContent.sup4: Gold efficiency: Support items provide scaling, complete your quest
tipsContent.archText: Even if you don't know a specific champion, you can figure out how to play them by their archetype. Here are the main categories:
tipsContent.arch1Desc: High mobility, burst damage. Look for isolated targets, delete squishies, escape.
tipsContent.arch2Desc: Tanky damage dealers. Dive backline or split push. Build one damage item, then tank.
tipsContent.arch3Desc: Engage/peel for team. Stack HP/resistances. Initiate fights with CC.
tipsContent.arch4Desc: Ranged DPS. Farm to 3 items, then scale. Stay max range. Win through sustained damage.
tipsContent.arch5Desc: Ability-based damage. Poke or burst patterns. Manage mana. Control zones with abilities.
tipsContent.arch6Desc: Buff allies, heal/shield. Stay back, enable carries. Build support items.
tipsContent.m1Text: Playing random champions is about growth, not just winning. Every game teaches you something new - how a champion feels, what counters them, what their power spikes are. Even losses are valuable learning experiences.
tipsContent.m2Text: Let your team know you're trying a new champion. Most players are understanding and might even give you tips.
tipsContent.m3Text: Don't expect to carry every game with unfamiliar champions. Set achievable goals: farm well, don't feed, learn the abilities, make smart decisions.
tipsContent.m4Text: Tilt is the enemy of learning. If you're getting frustrated, take a break. Remember that even pro players struggled when learning new champions.
tipsContent.a1Text: After playing a champion, take mental notes: What felt strong? What was difficult? What items worked? This knowledge compounds over time.
tipsContent.a2Text: Spend 2-3 minutes in practice tool before your match. Test ability ranges, practice combos, check damage numbers.
tipsContent.a3Text: Review your matches - what worked, what didn't? Use losses to identify areas for improvement beyond just champion mechanics.
tipsContent.a4Text: Watch high-level players on YouTube or Twitch. Even a 5-minute clip can teach you combos, builds, or playstyles.
tipsContent.finalText: Every random champion game makes you a better League of Legends player. Use these strategies, stay positive, and embrace the challenge!
